build_Trainer: build a Trainer instance with config, task, model, and criterion for distributed data parallel training
run_train_step: run a training step with forward pass, backward pass, gradient reduction, and optimizer update across GPUs
run_valid_step: run a validation step performing a forward pass in evaluation mode and logging validation stats
save_checkpoint: save all training state including model, criterion, optimizer, and lr scheduler to a checkpoint file
load_checkpoint: load training state from a checkpoint file and restore model, optimizer, and learning rate scheduler
